label: Paul, Epistula ad Romanos
author: Paul (Nova Vulgata, editio typica altera 1986)
work: Epistula ad Romanos (Nova Vulgata Bibliorum Sacrorum Editio)
notes: Latin text of Romans in the Nova Vulgata on vatican.va, the scriptural basis Dei Filius cites for natural knowledge of God (ch. 2 'Rom. I'; ch. 4 'a gentibus'). Dei Filius (1870) cites the Vulgate; the Nova Vulgata wording differs slightly ('noscibile'), which is noted where it matters. A pinned Greek witness would be the primary; this is the Latin the Church uses.
